description:
Fill a text field on the session's current page, located by a CSS selector.

Uses Playwright's fill(), which drives React/Vue-controlled inputs correctly (setting the DOM value directly does not). Requires a session opened with profile_start first. `selector` is a CSS selector, not an XPath.

Returns {ok: true}. Fails with a readable message if the session is not open (409 — call profile_start first), the identity does not exist (404), the selector matches several elements and no nth was given, or the selector never matches / the fill times out (502).

name.description: identity name, exactly as profiles_list reports it

nth.description: optional, 0-based: which element to use when the selector matches several. Leave it out and a selector that matches several elements fails with "matched N elements"; then write a more specific selector or pass nth

selector.description: CSS selector for the input to fill

text.description: the text to put in the field, replacing whatever was there

name: session_fill_selector
